title: Cross-bot job contract
description: Machine-readable handoff between Grok Bot agents and Cursor. Not the workshop record in job-record.schema.json. Task types work, validate, and gate are adapted from TaskType in Intelligent-Internet/zenith zenith_harness/models.py (Apache-2.0); this repository does not vendor that project. Cross-field rules (acyclic depends_on, one work owner and one owner_bot per criterion, COMMIT only when clock is τ4, sealed criteria not pending) are enforced by scripts/validate-job-contract.py.

job_id.description: Stable id for this cross-bot job.

owner_bot.description: Single bot id accountable for the job.

repo.description: Repository the job targets, owner/name or URL.

lane.description: Who executes the next step: a Cursor agent, or a Grok Bot.

protocol.description: Workflow the receiving agent must follow.

owner_bot.description: Exactly one bot id. Not a list.

sealed_by.description: Gate task id that sealed this criterion, or null when unsealed.

tasks.description: type values follow zenith_harness/models.py TaskType (Apache-2.0): work does the change, validate checks it, gate seals criteria.

covers_isc.description: Criterion ids this task addresses. Exactly one work task may cover each criterion. validate and gate may list the same id.

clock.description: τ1 task work, τ2 review, τ4 criteria-text change. COMMIT is legal only on τ4.

decision.description: COMMIT only with clock τ4. HOLD and REFUSE are legal on every clock. Otherwise none.

digest_id.description: Revision id for this contract document.

pr_url.description: Pull request URL, or empty when none exists yet.

rating.description: Phase 6 outcome, integer 1-10, or null before rating.
